name: algoflix-root
description: One-command launcher for AlgoFlix full-stack platform

scripts.start: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "red,cyan" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "red,cyan" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
